flow-definition.description: Mongodbserver_OPS: Backup and Restore Pipeline using Oplog

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: ACTION
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: Action to perform: Backup the database or Restore from an existing backup.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: TARGET_PRIVATE_IP
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Private IP of the MongoDB instance.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BASTION_IP
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Public IP of the Bastion Host (Leave empty if Jenkins can reach the Private IP directly).

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: SSH_USER
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: SSH username for the instances (e.g., ec2-user or ubuntu).

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: SECRET_NAME
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Name of the AWS secret containing the SSH key.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: MONGO_CREDENTIALS_SECRET
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: AWS Secret name containing MongoDB credentials.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BACKUP_DIR
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Local path on the Jenkins instance to store and retrieve backups.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: RESTORE_TIMESTAMP
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: For RESTORE only: The specific timestamp folder to restore (or "latest").

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: DROP_BEFORE_RESTORE
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: For RESTORE only: Drop existing collections before restoring data.
